title: Practice: an extraction pipeline that admits absence, checks what a schema cannot, retries with feedback and is measured on every document (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a document with every value present and quoted comes back valid on the first attempt
cases.says: A document with every value present and quoted comes back valid on the first attempt

cases.id: e1 a value the document does not give is null and needs no quote while an invented value fails as ungrounded
cases.says: A value the document does not give is null and needs no quote, while an invented value fails as ungrounded

cases.id: e2 a retry carries the original document the failed record and only the errors a second look can fix
cases.says: A retry carries the document, the failed record and only the errors a second look can fix

cases.id: e3 a required value that the model reports as absent is not retried and goes to review
cases.says: A required value reported as absent is not retried and goes to review

cases.id: e4 retries stop after the limit and the document is marked failed
cases.says: Retries stop after the limit and the document is marked failed

cases.id: e5 a total that differs from the line items is a semantic error and a flagged conflict goes to review without a retry
cases.says: A total that differs from the line items is a semantic error; a flagged conflict goes to review without a retry

cases.id: e6 currency takes unclear and other with a detail and rejects anything else as a syntax error
cases.says: Currency takes unclear and other with a detail, and anything else is a syntax error

cases.id: e7 chunk results merge by keeping the first value and recording a conflict when two chunks disagree
cases.says: Chunk results merge by keeping the first value and recording a conflict when two chunks disagree

cases.id: e8 accuracy counts every document and not only the validated ones
cases.says: Accuracy counts every document and not only the validated ones

cases.id: e9 the request forces a tool where the model allows it and falls back to auto with a reply check where it does not
cases.says: The request forces a tool where the model allows it and falls back to auto with a reply check where it does not
